title: Extract shared loadOrchestratorConfig helper
description: scripts/load-config.mjs and scripts/resolve-tasks.mjs both invoke loadLibraries() to get the synthesized config. Extract a single loadOrchestratorConfig({withSideEffects: bool}) helper so both consumers go through one entry point. Reduces drift risk.
acceptance_criteria: Both load-config.mjs and resolve-tasks.mjs route through the new helper
All 80 existing tests pass without modification
resolve-tasks.mjs CLI output unchanged for all 6 snapshot baselines
